message:
docs: use the title attribute on embedded videos

`<docs-video>` reads only `src` and `title`, so the `alt` attribute on two
pages is dropped and the play link falls back to a generic "Play video"
label. On the typed forms guide that loses the video's name from the
accessible label entirely.

Pass `title` on both, and fix the kitchen sink prose that tells authors a
video "just needs a `src` and `alt`", which is where the attribute came
from. The extension's own test fixture used `alt` as well and the spec
never asserted on the label, so add that assertion.
